items.title: AI routing leaked prompts across providers
items.oneliner: Researchers planted 2 million canaries and caught AI providers leaking secrets. Zero retention claims now need verification, not trust.

items.title: Ghostscript bug turns uploads into shells
items.oneliner: Ghostscript CVE-2026-125396 enables remote code execution through file uploads. Image pipelines just became part of your attack surface.

items.title: Anthropic's future power mix is fossil-heavy
items.oneliner: Anthropic's 2028 power mix is projected at 87% gas and 11% coal. AI scaling is now an energy procurement story.

items.title: Postgres now fits in one binary
items.oneliner: miniPG packages a full Postgres server and client into one executable. Local-first apps just got a much easier default.

items.title: A Rust server targets Python deployment pain
items.oneliner: Muru brings an AI-assisted Rust server to ASGI and WSGI deployment. Python infra keeps borrowing systems ideas from Rust.

items.title: Rust is being used surgically
items.oneliner: Fast-Anything rewrites only the slowest 5% in Rust. Teams can chase speedups without signing up for full rewrites.

items.title: Terraform gets a more realistic test loop
items.oneliner: An AWS emulator lets Terraform plans hit mock endpoints before apply. IaC debugging may finally move left.

items.title: Packet captures get instant triage
items.oneliner: PcapAnalyzer ships 27 detectors for local pcap analysis. Network forensics is getting faster without sending traffic off-box.

items.title: Minecraft scanning data triggered server bans
items.oneliner: A hobbyist's Minecraft scanner appears tied to Mojang server bans. Telemetry can become enforcement faster than developers expect.

items.title: Backblaze users are questioning the privacy shift
items.oneliner: Backblaze's policy update sparked fears around ad-related data sharing. Privacy promises remain a product feature until legal text changes.
